The lineup in this video was actually ridiculous 😮‍💨🔥

The Weeknd’s “Reminder” has officially surpassed 1.5 billion streams on Spotify, marking another huge milestone for one of the standout tracks from his Starboy era. Originally released in 2016, the song’s dark production, smooth vocals, and confident energy helped make it one of the most memorable records from the album. Nearly a decade later, it continues to pull in millions of listeners.

“Reminder” became even more memorable thanks to its iconic music video, which featured appearances from Drake, Travis Scott, A$AP Rocky, Metro Boomin, and several other major names. The video perfectly matched the larger-than-life energy of the Starboy era while giving fans a glimpse into The Weeknd’s world at the height of his rise to global superstardom.

The 1.5 billion milestone is another reminder of just how much staying power The Weeknd’s catalog has. “Reminder” continues to rack up hundreds of thousands of streams every day, proving that fans are still coming back to the track years after its release. With The Weeknd already holding the record for the most songs to reach Spotify’s Billion Club, another massive milestone only adds to his incredible streaming legacy.
